# Scrape Agent — llms.txt

> Pay-per-use web scraping for AI agents.
> $0.01 USD per request, paid in USDC via x402.
> No accounts. No subscriptions. No API key.

## Endpoint

POST https://scrapeagent.xyz/api/scrape/x402

## Payment

Protocol: x402
Asset: USDC
Price: $0.01 per request
Supported networks: Base (eip155:8453), Polygon (eip155:137)
Payment destination: provided in the x402 payment challenge

## Request format

{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "extract": "text | html | links | meta"
}

extract defaults to text.

## How agents should call it

1. POST the JSON request without payment.
2. Receive HTTP 402 with the x402 payment requirements.
3. Pay exactly $0.01 USDC using a compatible x402 client.
4. Retry the same POST request with the payment proof.
5. Receive the scraped JSON response.

## Response format

{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "extract": "text",
  "result": "Example Domain...",
  "statusCode": 200
}

## Discovery

OpenAPI: GET https://scrapeagent.xyz/openapi.json
x402 discovery: GET https://scrapeagent.xyz/.well-known/x402
